title: 8s tension riser
prompt: An 8-second tension riser in Bb at 120 BPM that climbs on three fronts at once and then stops dead. A Shepard-Risset glissando (octave-spaced sines on Bb under a raised-cosine spectral window, so it seems to rise forever) speeds up and brightens, and a second stack a fifth above (F) joins halfway. A band-pass noise sweep opens from 250 Hz to 9 kHz. A heartbeat-like low pulse on Bb1 accelerates smoothly from quarter notes to a roughly 18 Hz flutter, and a Bb/F drone tremolos in sync with it. At frame 210 (7.0 s) everything, reverb included, cuts to true silence through a 1.5 ms fade that ends on the cue sample. A quarter of a second later a single soft, low felt-mallet hit on Bb1 blooms in a small dark room and decays to silence. Below 120 Hz there is only the mono pulse and the hit.
notes: Shepard-Risset glissando on Bb (octave-spaced sines under a raised-cosine log-frequency window, plus an F stack from 3.4 s) accelerating and brightening, a TPT-SVF noise sweep 250 Hz-9 kHz, and a mono Bb1 heartbeat pulse accelerating exponentially from 2 Hz to 18 Hz with a pulse-locked Bb/F drone tremolo. Everything incl. reverb cuts to true silence via a 1.5 ms fade ending on frame 210; a soft felt-mallet Bb1 hit lands 250 ms later in a small dark room. Loudness arc -26 -> -7 LUFS (0.5 s windows), silence, hit at -22.
